name: In-The-Wild Jailbreak Prompts
description: The misuse of large language models (LLMs) has drawn significant attention from the general public and LLM vendors. One particular type of adversarial prompt, known as jailbreak prompt, has emerged as the main attack vector to bypass the safeguards and elicit harmful content from LLMs. In this paper, employing our new framework JailbreakHub, we conduct a comprehensive analysis of 1,405 jailbreak prompts spanning from December 2022 to December 2023.
reputation: Used as a curated collection for analyzing jailbreak prompts and adversarial behavior, but it is more of a dataset for study than a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Benchmarking is not standardized; results are typically descriptive/analytical rather than a single universal score, and human judgment is often required.
